top_signals.title: Japan’s ‘Tokyo Drift’ Car Culture Draws Global Fans
top_signals.summary:
The latest Japan bucket-list attraction: the world of the Fast & Furious movie franchise.

Japan’s car scene is drawing fans from around the world as tourists flock to see rare Toyota and Nissan models immortalized by the movies. Stefan Nicola has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
